name: Denmark-England
events: King Harold Harefoot dies at Oxford at the age of 24.
King Harthacnut invites his half-brother Edward the Confessor to return to England from exile in Normandy…
The city of Worcester rebels against the naval taxes of Harthacnut.
Edward the Confessor becomes Monarch of England
Magnus the Good becomes Monarch of Denmark
Edward the Confessor is crowned king of England at Winchester Cathedral.
Edward the Confessor, King of England, marries Edith of Wessex (daughter of Earl Godwin) and she is crowned…
